what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Austria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9258 Iraqi refugees in Austria, 3.4% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq from 1993 to 1996 and in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them.
From 2004 the government's opponents it records include the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam, IS and RJF.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 1820 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 10340, at the end of 2022, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
These are year-end totals for Austria only, reported to UNHCR.
